source_text: Verum quoniam de tantis et talibus rebus disserentibus non sufficit humanis sensibus... assumenda sunt nobis... etiam divinarum scripturarum testimonia.
pass_a_gloss: Since in treating such great matters human senses are not enough, we must also take the testimonies of the divine Scriptures.
pass_b_english: Book IV opens: for matters this great, common notions are not enough; we take as proof the testimonies of the writings believed divine — old covenant and new — [[God-breathed Scripture >> Bible:2 Timothy 3:16]].
